Aldar Properties

An ADX-listed Abu Dhabi property group developing and managing master-planned communities across Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, Al Raha and Reem Island.

  • Master-planned residential communities
  • Commercial, retail and hospitality investment
  • Government housing and infrastructure delivery (Aldar Projects)
  • Education and community services

Modon

An Abu Dhabi-based, ADX-listed holding company whose real estate arm is master-developing Hudayriyat Island alongside projects on Reem Island.

Bloom Holding

Reportage Group
